units.source_text: 今天晚上我还背下和歌百首集里的诗歌，能把纸牌的假名读下来了。

en.t: Tonight I also memorized poems from the One Hundred Poems anthology and became able to read the kana on the cards.

units.source_text: 然而，玩起纸牌来，我仿佛还不如原先那个漫不经心地动动手的神童，

en.t: However, when it came to actually playing cards, I seemed to be no match for the child prodigy I had once been, who moved his hands so casually,

units.source_text: 反而觉得困难、变得笨拙了。

en.t: and instead I found it difficult and became clumsy.
